summary: Grounds: a channel about the money and craft of running a coffee shop. Warm darkroom browns, cream type, one amber accent; an editorial serif for headlines, a clean sans for labels, mono for every number. Calm and confident, documentary pace.
text: Sentence case; small labels may be uppercase with wide tracking
Never more than two lines on screen

pace.label: documentary pace: moves settle in 300-500 ms

graphics: Thin 2px rules and outlines, no drop shadows, no gradients, no glass
